outcome: profile of preeclampsia patients with aggravating factors
incidence of eclampsia and HELLP syndrome
cohort: 109 preeclampsia patients admitted to the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department of Cipto Mangunkusumo Hospital from January to June 2021
finding: Common aggravating factors in preeclampsia patients were multiple pregnancies (10.1%), chronic hypertension (5.5%), and diabetes (5.5%).
